_comment: KMD2 input schema for generate_kmd.py. Real e-MTA element names (NOT Line1_1…Line13). declaration_body values are taxable BASES by rate, EXCEPT inputVatTotal/importVat/fixedAssetsVat/carsVat which are VAT amounts. e-MTA computes total VAT (line 4), VAT due (line 12) and overpaid (line 13) itself — do not supply them (no such element/column exists). Output: a KMD2 machine CSV (primary) + XSD-validated vatDeclaration XML (secondary). All monetary values are EUR decimals with a dot.
_comment_cash_accounting: State it explicitly. true only if the company applies the special arrangements for cash accounting for VAT (kassapõhine, VAT Act § 44). KMD INF A column 8 (invoiceSumForRate) and B column 7 (vatSum) are 'filled in by taxable persons using cash-accounting for value added tax' (EMTA KMD INF instructions 2025-07); the generator refuses either field unless cash_accounting is true. Exception: a part B line with special code 11 (partial deduction, VAT Act § 32 / § 29(4)) in comments may carry vatSum.
_comment_declaration_body: KMD main form (declarationBody). Omit or set 0 for lines that do not apply. Rate lines feed e-MTA's line-4 computation and INCLUDE reverse-charge/IC acquisition bases (EMTA: the KMD is declared by rate 'including' IC acquisition and reverse-charge services). Their deductible VAT goes into inputVatTotal (line 5); for full deduction the two cancel. Lines 6/6.1/7/7.1 are INFORMATIVE breakouts (EU suppliers -> line 6; non-EU services + domestic reverse charge -> line 7) and must not exceed the rate-line bases — the generator rejects that.
_comment_sales_annex: KMD INF A (salesAnnex): invoices issued to partners whose invoices WITHOUT VAT total at least EUR 1,000.00 in the period (inclusive; ordinary and credit invoices totalled separately; only invoices with supply at 24/22/20/13/9/5 % count). Select partners with `generate_kmd.py --select-inf invoices.json --side A`. buyerRegCode = register code or personal ID code assigned in Estonia (never a VAT number). Omit the whole key when no partner qualifies — output then sets noSales=true. EMTA's form is filled invoice-by-invoice: sum_per_partner=false with invoiceNumber + invoiceDate (YYYY-MM-DD, rendered DD.MM.YYYY in the CSV). invoiceSum = invoice total without VAT; taxRate = classifier value (e.g. '24', '24erikord'); sumForRateInPeriod = base declared on KMD lines 1/1¹/1²/2/2¹/2² this period. invoiceSumForRate (column 8) only when cash_accounting is true.
_comment_purchases_annex: KMD INF B (purchasesAnnex): invoices received from partners whose invoices WITHOUT VAT total at least EUR 1,000.00 in the period, counting only invoices whose VAT is deducted in KMD line 5 this period. invoiceSumVat = invoice total WITH VAT (column 6); vatInPeriod = input VAT declared on line 5 for that invoice this period (column 8). vatSum (column 7) only when cash_accounting is true, or with special code 11 for a partial deduction. Omit the key when no partner qualifies.
